title: Mario & Luigi: Bowser's Inside Story
subtitle: Native PC port through static recompilation
status: Work in progress – runs up to the file select screen, no sound yet
about: A role-playing adventure from the Mario & Luigi series, originally released for the Nintendo DS in 2009.

Bowser accidentally swallows the Mario brothers. While he fights his way through the Mushroom Kingdom on the outside, Mario and Luigi explore his body from the inside, and both sides have to help each other. Battles are turn-based, but timed button presses decide how well attacks and defense work.
port: The game's ARM9 machine code is translated to C ahead of time and compiled for your PC. A platform layer reimplements the parts of the DS hardware the game uses: graphics (2D and 3D), input, timers, DMA, the cartridge and the second processor.
Nothing from the game is part of this project. The launcher checks your own copy of the game, extracts the data it needs and starts the port.
